doc.description: AE4317 course navigation module. Receives 12-slice obstacle danger values (0-100) via PAYLOAD_DATA ABI from the vision team. Finds the widest gap of free slices and steers toward it. Falls back to weighted-centroid turning when fully blocked. Set OBSTACLE_DETECTION_ID to match the sender ID used by the vision module.

define.name: OBSTACLE_DETECTION_ID
define.description: ABI sender ID of the vision module publishing 12-slice danger values via PAYLOAD_DATA.

dl_setting.description: Danger score below which a slice is free (0-100)
Minimum adjacent free slices for a valid gap
